evidence.title: Missing 72-year-old hiker found alive days after frightening 100-foot fall left her badly injured

occurrences.checkable_against: Siskiyou County Sheriff's Office press release about Mary Beth Granbery
occurrences.quote_span: Mary Beth Granbery, a Mount Shasta resident, departed for a multi-day camping trip on Sept. 28 and was expected to return by Oct. 1, according to a press release from Siskiyou County Sheriff's Office.
occurrences.speaker: Siskiyou County Sheriff's Office
occurrences.subject: Mary Beth Granbery rescue near Cabin Creek

occurrences.checkable_against: Shasta County Sheriff's Office transport records and Mercy Medical Center admission records
occurrences.quote_span: She was taken to Mercy Medical Center in Redding for treatment, the sheriff's office said.
occurrences.speaker: Shasta County Sheriff's Office
occurrences.subject: Mary Beth Granbery rescue near Cabin Creek

occurrences.checkable_against: California Highway Patrol Air Operations flight and rescue records
occurrences.quote_span: With Granbery injured in difficult terrain, California Highway Patrol (CHP) Air Operations assisted in getting her out of the area.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Mary Beth Granbery rescue near Cabin Creek

occurrences.checkable_against: Shasta County Sheriff's Office statement and Granbery's medical records
occurrences.quote_span: "[Granbery] is in stable condition, and her injuries are non-life threatening," the Shasta County Sheriff's Office wrote.

occurrences.subject: Mary Beth Granbery rescue near Cabin Creek

occurrences.checkable_against: Siskiyou County Sheriff's Office missing-person report or press release

occurrences.subject: Mary Beth Granbery rescue near Cabin Creek
